recap.text: Mordecai says the rules are a little weird about taming dungeon pets: remove the creature's hostility first, then come back. Mongo screams and hisses at him from his cage the whole time. Carl and Donut then open their boxes from the boss fight. Donut "coincidentally" receives a spell book of Heal Critter, and Carl gets another Potion of Determine Value and a thousand gold.

Heal Critter lands on Donut's list at level one. Half the street where she and Carl were just standing explodes and throws them forward, with rocks and debris raining down, and Mongo squeals in pain. Donut casts Heal Critter and he glows. She rushes to the small, blood-splattered dinosaur, clucking over him worriedly.

Donut, in the flying house during a storm, sends Carl a message in capitals while he fights feral scorpions in a sandstorm. She writes that she cast Heal Critter and it worked, and she can't believe it. The health is still going down, though, and the stupid dog doesn't even appreciate the spell.

Weighing a vehicle against a mount, Donut points to her Twinkle Toes spell and her level-15 Heal Critter. Hedy the gremlin, on the floor fighting another gremlin, gasps that pet spells don't work on special mounts. Neither Twinkle Toes nor Heal Critter will work on them.
